data.name: Alfalfa growth since cutting
data.title: Alfalfa growth since cutting
data.description: Growing degree days (base 41 °F, upper 86 °F) since spring or the last cutting, and when alfalfa is ready to cut (900–1100 GDD).

outputs.name: gdd_total
outputs.label: GDD (41/86 °F) since spring or the last cutting

data.name: Apple scab
data.title: Apple scab
data.description: Primary apple scab infection periods from wet hours and temperature, with the share of the season's ascospores mature and released, from green tip until they're released.

outputs.name: dd_total
outputs.label: Degree days since green tip (base 0 °C, rain-adjusted)

data.name: Apple bud and bloom stages
data.title: Apple bud and bloom stages
data.description: Apple's stages from silver tip to fruit set, by degree days (base 43 °F) from January 1, at the thresholds NEWA uses.

data.name: Botrytis leaf blight (BOTCAST)
data.title: Botrytis leaf blight (BOTCAST)
data.description: BOTCAST's daily disease severity index from inoculum and infection conditions, accumulated from emergence to time fungicide sprays for Botrytis leaf blight of onion.

data.name: Carrot foliar blight disease severity values (TOMCAST)
data.title: Carrot foliar blight disease severity values (TOMCAST)
data.description: Daily disease severity values (0–4) from hours of leaf wetness and their temperature, for Alternaria and Cercospora leaf blights of carrot: the total since planting or the last spray times fungicide sprays, and the last 7 days' total sets the risk level.

outputs.name: dsv_total
outputs.label: DSVs since planting or the last spray

data.name: Cercospora leaf spot daily infection values
data.title: Cercospora leaf spot daily infection values
data.description: Daily infection values (0–7) from hours of high humidity and their temperature; their 2- and 7-day means time fungicide sprays for Cercospora leaf spot of table and sugar beet.

data.name: Corn growth stages
data.title: Corn growth stages
data.description: Corn's vegetative and reproductive stages from planting, by growing degree days (modified 50/86 °F), for any hybrid maturity.

data.name: Cotton planting stand risk
data.title: Cotton planting stand risk
data.description: For each possible planting date, the predicted emerged cotton stand in plants per acre, with its 95% confidence interval, from the rain over the next 3 days and the minimum temperatures over the next 9, compared with a yield-limiting stand.

data.name: Gibberella ear rot DON probability
data.title: Gibberella ear rot DON probability
data.description: The probability of DON above 1 ppm from Gibberella ear rot, from temperature and rain 21 to 7 days before and humidity over the last 14 days; corn is susceptible during silking.

data.name: Early blight P-days
data.title: Early blight P-days
data.description: Potato physiological days from daily minimum and maximum temperature, accumulated from emergence to time the first fungicide spray for early blight (about 300 P-days).

data.name: Fire blight (blossom blight)
data.title: Fire blight (blossom blight)
data.description: Fire blight blossom infection risk during bloom, by Cougarblight 2010's four-day temperature risk and MaryBlyt's infection potential, with wetting and expected symptoms.

outputs.name: symptoms_dd
outputs.label: Degree days since the latest MaryBlyt infection (base 55 °F)

data.name: Frogeye leaf spot spore probability
data.title: Frogeye leaf spot spore probability
data.description: The probability of frogeye leaf spot spores being present, from a month of maximum temperature and humid hours; soybean is susceptible from R1 (flowering) to R5 (beginning seed).

data.name: Gray leaf spot spore probability
data.title: Gray leaf spot spore probability
data.description: The probability of gray leaf spot spores being present, from three weeks of minimum temperature and a month of minimum dew point; corn is susceptible from V10 to R3.

data.name: Late blight disease severity values
data.title: Late blight disease severity values
data.description: Daily disease severity values (0–4) from hours of high humidity and their temperature, accumulated from potato emergence (or a date you enter, such as tomato transplanting or the last spray) to time fungicide sprays for late blight of potato and tomato.

data.name: Oak wilt vector flight
data.title: Oak wilt vector flight
data.description: The risk of oak wilt spreading by its beetle vectors, from their flight timed by degree days (base 41 °F) and the season (wounding before mid-July).

data.name: Pecan scab hours
data.title: Pecan scab hours
data.description: Hours warm (70 °F or more) and humid (RH 90% or more) since March 1 or the last fungicide spray, and whether a spray is advised: the total has reached the threshold for your variety's susceptibility and the waiting period after March 1 or the last spray has passed.

outputs.name: scab_hours_total
outputs.label: Scab hours since March 1 or the last spray

outputs.name: scab_hours_14_day
outputs.label: Scab hours in the last 14 days

outputs.name: days_since_start
outputs.label: Days since March 1 or the last spray

outputs.name: wait_days_left
outputs.label: Days left in the waiting period

data.name: Potato emergence
data.title: Potato emergence
data.description: The date half of a potato planting has emerged, by degree days in air above 4 °C from planting: the start of the early and late blight models.

data.name: Potato volunteer survival
data.title: Potato volunteer survival
data.description: Whether potato tubers left in the field are likely to survive the winter, from the hours of soil below 27 °F at 2, 4 and 8 in; surviving volunteers can carry late blight and insect pests into the next season.

outputs.name: killing_hours_4cm
outputs.label: Hours below 27 °F at 2 in (4 cm) since November 1

outputs.name: killing_hours_10cm
outputs.label: Hours below 27 °F at 4 in (10 cm) since November 1

outputs.name: killing_hours_8in
outputs.label: Hours below 27 °F at 8 in (10–30 cm interpolated) since November 1

outputs.name: projected_risk_level
outputs.label: Risk level, projected to the season's end (median)

outputs.name: projected_killing_hours_4cm
outputs.label: Hours below 27 °F at 2 in (4 cm) since November 1, projected to the season's end (median)

outputs.name: projected_killing_hours_10cm
outputs.label: Hours below 27 °F at 4 in (10 cm) since November 1, projected to the season's end (median)

outputs.name: projected_killing_hours_8in
outputs.label: Hours below 27 °F at 8 in (10–30 cm interpolated) since November 1, projected to the season's end (median)

outputs.label: Chance the season ends at Low risk

outputs.name: chance_moderate
outputs.label: Chance the season ends at Moderate risk

outputs.name: chance_high
outputs.label: Chance the season ends at High risk

outputs.name: chance_very_high
outputs.label: Chance the season ends at Very high risk

data.name: Red crown rot incidence
data.title: Red crown rot incidence
data.description: Predicted share of soybean plants with red crown rot, from temperature and rain in the month either side of the beginning of flowering (R1).

data.name: Winter rye cover crop biomass
data.title: Winter rye cover crop biomass
data.description: Spring biomass of a fall-planted cereal rye cover crop, from growing degree days (base 32 °F) since planting, against the biomass cover crop goals need. Fitted on Wisconsin data, mostly from southern and central Wisconsin.

outputs.name: planting_outside_data
outputs.label: Planting date outside the model's data

data.name: Soybean Cercospora leaf blight spore probability
data.title: Soybean Cercospora leaf blight spore probability
data.description: Spore probabilities for three Cercospora species causing leaf blight of soybean, from recent temperature, dew point depression, wind and humid hours.

data.name: Soybean growth stages
data.title: Soybean growth stages
data.description: Soybean's vegetative and reproductive stages from planting, from temperature and day length, for any maturity group (SOYDEV).

data.name: Spring wheat growth stages
data.title: Spring wheat growth stages
data.description: Spring wheat's Haun stages from planting through flowering and watery-ripe kernels, by growing degree days (base 32 °F).

data.name: Tar spot risk
data.title: Tar spot risk
data.description: The probability that recent weather has favored tar spot increasing in a corn field, from a month of temperature and humidity; corn is susceptible from V10 (10th leaf) to R3 (milk).

data.name: Wheat scab (Fusarium head blight) probability
data.title: Wheat scab (Fusarium head blight) probability
data.description: The probability of severe Fusarium head blight (scab) for wheat flowering on the day shown, from the mean humidity of the two weeks before, for the variety's resistance class.

outputs.name: probability
outputs.label: Probability of severe head blight, for the chosen resistance

data.name: White mold apothecia probability
data.title: White mold apothecia probability
data.description: The probability of white mold apothecia in soybean fields, from a month of temperature, humidity and wind (non-irrigated) or temperature, humidity and row spacing (irrigated); susceptible from R1 to R3.

data.name: Alfalfa weevil
data.title: Alfalfa weevil
data.description: Times alfalfa weevil egg hatch, larval feeding, pupation and new adults from degree days since January 1 (base 48 °F), on NEWA's model, and marks when to scout stem tips for feeding on the first crop.

outputs.name: generations_pupae_in_cocoons
outputs.label: Generations of pupae in cocoons complete

outputs.name: window_scout_stem_tips_for_larval_feeding
outputs.label: Scout stem tips for larval feeding

data.name: Aphid PVY vectors
data.title: Aphid PVY vectors
data.description: Estimates the typical risk of potato virus Y spread by winged aphids through the season, by degree days or calendar date, using curves fitted to Wisconsin's suction trap catches.

data.name: Black cutworm
data.title: Black cutworm
data.description: Times black cutworm egg laying, leaf feeding and the cutting stages from degree days after a significant moth capture, your trap date or May 1, so you know when to scout seedlings for cutting.

outputs.name: window_scout_and_treat_while_caterpillars_can_cut_plants
outputs.label: Scout and treat while caterpillars can cut plants

data.name: Cabbage looper
data.title: Cabbage looper
data.description: Times cabbage looper egg laying and caterpillar feeding from degree days since the first moth caught in a pheromone trap, or July 15 without one, for each generation to the season's end, and marks when to scout for small caterpillars.

data.name: Cabbage maggot
data.title: Cabbage maggot
data.description: Times cabbage maggot fly flights and the root feeding that follows from degree days since January 1, by NEWA's model with a longer generation from New York and Wisconsin trap studies, and marks when to have seedlings and transplants protected during each flight.

outputs.name: window_protect_seedlings_and_transplants_during_fly_flight
outputs.label: Protect seedlings and transplants during fly flight

data.name: Codling moth
data.title: Codling moth
data.description: Times codling moth flight and egg hatch in apple orchards from degree days, from your first trap catch or one estimated for your latitude, and marks when to protect fruit during each generation's egg hatch.

outputs.name: dd_after_first_catch
outputs.label: Degree days since the first catch

outputs.name: first_catch_dd_estimate
outputs.label: Expected degree days from January 1 to the first catch here

outputs.name: first_catch_estimated
outputs.label: The first catch is estimated (1) or given (0)

outputs.name: second_generation_size
outputs.label: Size of the second generation (1: none, 2: up to a third, 3: a third to two thirds, 4: more than two thirds, 5: a full second and a partial third)

data.name: Colorado potato beetle
data.title: Colorado potato beetle
data.description: Follows Colorado potato beetle adults, egg masses and larvae through the season, by degree days or calendar date, using curves fitted to a decade of scouting counts in central Wisconsin's potato fields.

outputs.name: count_adults_and_larvae
outputs.label: Adults and larvae per 25 sweeps (typical count)

data.name: Colorado Potato Beetle (Adults)
data.title: Colorado Potato Beetle (Adults)

data.name: Colorado Potato Beetle (Larvae)
data.title: Colorado Potato Beetle (Larvae)

data.name: Common asparagus beetle
data.title: Common asparagus beetle
data.description: Follows common asparagus beetles from the overwintered adults feeding and laying eggs on spears in spring through up to three generations, from degree days since January 1 by UW–Madison's method, and marks when to scout for beetles and eggs.

outputs.name: activity_adults_feeding_and_laying_eggs

outputs.name: generations_adults_feeding_and_laying_eggs
outputs.label: Generations of adults feeding and laying eggs complete

data.name: Corn earworm
data.title: Corn earworm
data.description: Times corn earworm caterpillars in sweet corn ears from degree days after egg laying, from the day you first find eggs on silks or catch a significant moth flight, or August 15 without a date.

outputs.name: generations_larvae_in_ears
outputs.label: Generations of larvae in ears complete

data.name: Corn rootworm
data.title: Corn rootworm
data.description: Times corn rootworm egg hatch, larvae feeding on corn roots and the beetles that follow from air-temperature degree days since January 1 (base 52 °F), on Wisconsin's northern corn rootworm study, and marks when to dig and rate roots.

outputs.name: generations_larvae_feeding_on_roots
outputs.label: Generations of larvae feeding on roots complete

outputs.name: window_dig_and_rate_roots_for_larval_injury
outputs.label: Dig and rate roots for larval injury

data.name: Crucifer flea beetle
data.title: Crucifer flea beetle
data.description: Times crucifer flea beetle adults from degree days since January 1, the overwintered beetles that feed on seedlings and transplants in spring and the new adults of late summer, and marks when to scout new plantings every one to two days.

outputs.name: window_scout_new_plantings_every_one_to_two_days
outputs.label: Scout new plantings every one to two days

data.name: European corn borer
data.title: European corn borer
data.description: Times European corn borer moth flights, egg laying and young caterpillars from degree days since January 1, and marks when to scout and treat young caterpillars before they bore into the plant, with two generations in southern and central Wisconsin and one in the north.

outputs.name: window_scout_and_treat_young_larvae_before_they_bore_in
outputs.label: Scout and treat young larvae before they bore in

outputs.name: normal_dd_modified_50_86_to_08_01
outputs.label: The 30-year normal total of degree days (modified average, 50/86 °F) from January 1 through August 1, averaged over land within about 6 miles (10 km)

data.name: Green peach aphid
data.title: Green peach aphid
data.description: Shows the typical season's flight of winged green peach aphids in Wisconsin, by calendar date or degree days, from curves fitted to the state's suction trap catches.

outputs.name: count_winged_adults
outputs.label: Green peach aphids per suction trap per week (typical catch)

data.name: Imported cabbageworm
data.title: Imported cabbageworm
data.description: Times the cabbage white butterfly's flights, egg laying and imported cabbageworm caterpillar feeding from degree days since January 1, for each generation through the season, and marks when to scout for eggs and young caterpillars.

outputs.name: window_scout_for_eggs_and_young_caterpillars
outputs.label: Scout for eggs and young caterpillars

data.name: Japanese beetle
data.title: Japanese beetle
data.description: Follows Japanese beetle adult activity through the summer from degree days since January 1, by Oregon State's model, and marks when to scout for beetles feeding, from the first beetles at about 920 degree days to the end of main activity at about 2,100.

data.name: Mint flea beetle
data.title: Mint flea beetle
data.description: Follows mint flea beetle larvae in the roots and adults on the leaves from degree days since January 1 (base 41 °F), by Oregon State's model, and marks when to sweep mint for adults as they emerge.

data.name: Mint root borer
data.title: Mint root borer
data.description: Follows mint root borer moth flight and the larvae feeding in mint roots from degree days since April 1 (base 50 °F), by Oregon State's model, and marks when to trap or sweep for moths.

outputs.name: generations_larvae_in_roots
outputs.label: Generations of larvae in roots complete

data.name: Onion maggot
data.title: Onion maggot
data.description: Times the three onion maggot fly flights and the feeding that follows from degree days since January 1, by NEWA's model, and marks when onion plantings should be protected during each flight.

outputs.name: window_protect_onion_seedlings_during_fly_flight
outputs.label: Protect onion seedlings during fly flight

data.name: Potato aphid
data.title: Potato aphid
data.description: Shows the typical season's potato aphid counts in central Wisconsin potato fields, by degree days or calendar date, from curves fitted to a decade of scouting counts.

data.name: Seedcorn maggot
data.title: Seedcorn maggot
data.description: Times each generation's adult flight and the larval feeding that follows from degree days since January 1, and marks the windows when planting a susceptible crop is most likely to be hit.

data.name: Spotted Wing Drosophila
data.title: Spotted Wing Drosophila
data.description: Estimates how active spotted wing drosophila adults are through the season from degree days, using a curve fitted to weekly trap catches in Wisconsin tart cherry orchards.

outputs.name: count_adult_activity
outputs.label: Flies per trap per week (typical year)

data.name: Squash vine borer
data.title: Squash vine borer
data.description: Follows squash vine borer moth flight and egg laying, and the larvae boring in the vines, from degree days since January 1 (modified average, 50/86 °F), and marks when to protect stems during egg laying, from about 825 to 1,240 degree days.

outputs.name: activity_moth_flight_and_egg_laying
outputs.label: Moth flight and egg laying activity

outputs.name: generations_moth_flight_and_egg_laying
outputs.label: Generations of moth flight and egg laying complete

outputs.name: generations_larvae_in_vines
outputs.label: Generations of larvae in vines complete

data.name: Stalk borer
data.title: Stalk borer
data.description: Times stalk borer caterpillars moving from grasses and weeds into corn from degree days since January 1, and marks the window to scout field borders and treat if needed.

outputs.name: generations_caterpillars_moving_into_corn
outputs.label: Generations of caterpillars moving into corn complete

outputs.name: window_scout_corn_borders_and_treat_if_needed
outputs.label: Scout corn borders and treat if needed

data.name: Tarnished plant bug
data.title: Tarnished plant bug
data.description: Retired. No study times the tarnished plant bug's spring generation by degree days, so the model's generations had no supported start.

data.name: Variegated cutworm
data.title: Variegated cutworm
data.description: Times variegated cutworm's two moth flights and the caterpillars from each from degree days since January 1, and marks when to scout for eggs and young caterpillars after each flight's peak.

outputs.name: window_scout_for_eggs_and_young_caterpillars
outputs.label: Scout for eggs and young caterpillars

data.name: Western bean cutworm
data.title: Western bean cutworm
data.description: Times the western bean cutworm moth flight and the egg masses that follow from degree days since March 1, on Hanson et al.'s 2015 model, which NEWA also uses, and marks when to scout corn for egg masses.

data.name: Western Flower Thrips
data.title: Western Flower Thrips
data.description: Retired. Western flower thrips don't survive the winter outdoors in Wisconsin, so degree days from January 1 don't time them here.
